2. [EVENT] User expressed interest in attending a festival in North Wales to experience its cultural traditions.
3. [ASSISTANT_SAID] The geography and landscape of North Wales influence the cultural traditions of its people, including the preservation of the Welsh language and traditional activities like sheep farming and slate mining.
4. [ASSISTANT_SAID] The National Eisteddfod of Wales is an annual festival celebrating the Welsh language, literature, music, and folk traditions.
5. [ASSISTANT_SAID] The Conwy Feast is an annual food festival in Conwy that celebrates local food and drink, along with music, arts, and crafts.
6. [ASSISTANT_SAID] The Royal Welsh Show is a major agricultural show held annually in Llanelwedd, showcasing Welsh farming and rural life.
7. [ASSISTANT_SAID] The Llangollen International Musical Eisteddfod is an annual music and dance festival held in Llangollen, attracting artists from around the world.
8. [ASSISTANT_SAID] The Anglesey Agricultural Show is a two-day agricultural show held annually on the Isle of Anglesey, showcasing Welsh livestock and farm produce.
9. [PREFERENCE] User expressed a desire to attend the National Eisteddfod of Wales.
10. [ASSISTANT_SAID] The National Eisteddfod of Wales in 2021 was held in Llantwit Major, Vale of Glamorgan, South Wales, from August 30th to September 4th, 2021.
11. [ASSISTANT_SAID] The Eisteddfod features Welsh language competitions, music and dance performances, visual art exhibitions, and more.
12. [ASSISTANT_SAID] User can find more information about tickets, events, and locations on the National Eisteddfod of Wales' official website.
